title: 第21章 玩家们的觉醒第22章 得灵种赠灵石
lines: 在姜望前往伏龙城的这几日。
望仙门据点的日常工作并未停滞。
但三名玩家那颗追求“自由度”
和“游戏性”
的心，开始愈发躁动起来。
莽穿地球无疑是三人中目前战力最强的。
体魄与根骨双双突破2.0。
又身负《莽牛劲》与《游身步》两门武学。
实力的大幅提升，让他不再满足于据点周边那点“安全区”
在完成了每日必备的清理和收集任务后，他将大部分精力投入到了更远的探索中。
不过探索也并非总能有惊天发现。
像清灵泉和筑基修士洞府那种机缘可遇不可求。
但收获依然存在。
在一次探索过程中，他在一片看似普通的树林地里，发现了几株质地异常坚硬的铁木，寻常斧刃砍上去只能留下浅浅的白痕，反震之力却让手臂发麻。
要知道他现在的身体素质可不一般。
他立刻意识到这绝非普通木材，说不定是什么珍贵材料，便连忙仔细做好标记，准备之后禀报门主。
除了探索，他也开始着手改善据点的生存条件。
防御是首要考虑。
他利用探索时找到的坚韧藤蔓和削尖的木桩，在据点外围设置了几个简易的绊索和陷坑陷阱，虽然粗糙，但至少能起到预警和迟滞的作用。
他还发挥力气大的优势，伐来粗大的原木，掏空中心，制作了几个硕大的水缸和水桶。
然后，每日的打水任务就成了他的专属。
施展起《游身步》。
只见他身形在林木间几个腾挪，脚尖在粗壮的树枝上轻轻一点，便能借力飘出数丈，衣袂带风，竟真有了几分传说中轻功高手飞檐走壁的潇洒。
往返五公里外的清灵泉，对他而言不再是辛苦的跋涉，反而成了一种身法的练习。
看着他将一桶桶清澈甘冽的泉水倒入水缸，储备起来，剑斩红尘和琉璃仙梦只有羡慕的份。
清灵泉每日一次的属性提升效果，在前三天发挥了神效，后面就效果大减了。
每人各增加了0.3点属性。
这相比于每日劳作的零点零几的微小提升，已经不算少。
琉璃仙梦的体魄和根骨终于双双达到了1.5。
身法《游身步》虽然要根骨达到2.0才能修炼。
但《莽牛劲》的修炼要求已经满足。
当她再一次按照秘籍引导，感受到体内那微弱却真实存在的气血流动时，激动得几乎要跳起来。
尽管只是最基础的武学，但意义非凡。
而剑斩红尘，也靠着这0.3的属性点加成。
成功将自己的“体魄”
和“根骨”
提升到了1.0，达到了普通健康成年人的平均水平。
虽然依旧是三人中垫底，但至少摆脱了“病弱”
的范畴。
干起活来效率也明显提升，不再像之前那样动不动就气喘吁吁。
属性的整体提升，反馈到实际工作中，就是清理废墟、收集材料的效率大大提高。
据点中央的广场被清理得越发平整开阔，收集来的木材和石料也堆成了小山。
眼看着莽穿地球探索创意不断。
琉璃仙梦也找逐渐到了自己的方向
content_en:
In the past few days when Jiang Wang went to Fulong City.
The daily work at Wangxianmen stronghold has not stopped.
But which of the three players pursues “freedom”?
and "gameplay"
My heart began to become more and more restless.
Mang Chuan Earth is undoubtedly the most powerful among the three.
Both physique and bones have exceeded 2.0.
He is also responsible for the two martial arts schools of "Rang Niu Jin" and "You Shen Bu".
With the substantial improvement in strength, he is no longer satisfied with the "safe zone" around the stronghold.
After completing the necessary daily cleaning and collecting tasks, he devoted most of his energy to exploring further.
But exploration doesn’t always lead to shocking discoveries.
Opportunities like the Qingling Spring and the Foundation-Building Monk Cave are hard to come by.
But the gains remain.
During an exploration, he discovered several ironwood trees with unusually hard texture in a seemingly ordinary forest. An ordinary ax blade would only leave shallow white marks when struck, but the force of the shock would make his arms numb.
You must know that his current physical fitness is extraordinary.
He immediately realized that this was no ordinary wood, and might be some kind of precious material, so he quickly marked it carefully and prepared to report it to the door owner.
In addition to exploration, he also began to improve the living conditions of the stronghold.
Defense is the primary concern.
He used the tough vines and sharpened wooden stakes he found during exploration to set up several simple trip wires and pit traps around the stronghold. Although crude, they could at least serve as an early warning and delay.
He also took advantage of his strength to cut down thick logs, hollowed out the center, and made several huge water jars and buckets.
Then, the daily task of fetching water became his exclusive responsibility.
Use "Wandering Step".
I could see his figure moving among the trees. He could float several feet away with a tap of his toes on the thick branches. His clothes were carrying the wind, and he actually looked a bit as cool as the legendary Qinggong master flying over walls and walls.
The round trip to Qingling Spring, which is five kilometers away, is no longer a hard trek for him, but has become a physical exercise.
Watching him pour buckets of clear and sweet spring water into the water tank and reserve it, Jian Zhan Hongchen and Liuli Xianmeng could only envy him.
The once-a-day attribute improvement effect of Qingling Spring was miraculous in the first three days, but the effect was greatly reduced after that.
Each person increased their attributes by 0.3 points.
Compared with the small improvement of a few tenths of daily labor, this is not a small improvement.
Liuli Xianmeng's physique and bones finally reached 1.5.
Although the body technique "Wandering Body Step" requires a root bone of 2.0 to be practiced.
But the training requirements of "Mang Niu Jin" have been met.
When she once again followed the guidance of the secret book and felt the weak but real flow of Qi and blood in her body, she almost jumped with excitement.
Although it is only the most basic martial arts, it is of great significance.
And Sword Cutting Hongchen also relies on this 0.3 attribute point bonus.
Successfully transform your “body”
and "root bone"
It has improved to 1.0, reaching the average level of ordinary healthy adults.
Although he is still at the bottom among the three, at least he has got rid of the "sickness"
category.
The efficiency of working has also been significantly improved, and I am no longer out of breath like before.
The overall improvement in attributes is fed back into actual work, which means that the efficiency of cleaning up ruins and collecting materials is greatly improved.
The square in the center of the stronghold was cleared to become smoother and wider, and the collected wood and stones were piled into hills.
Watch as Mang travels across the earth to explore and create new ideas.
Liuli Xianmeng also gradually found her own direction
